opportunities.name: KAYAK hotel search by destination, dates and guests
opportunities.description: Search hotels on KAYAK for a given destination, check-in/check-out dates, and room and guest counts, then sort or filter the results.
steps: Click 'Search for hotels' (Stays) on the KAYAK home page.
Click the destination field 'Enter a city, hotel, airport, address or landmark', type the destination and click the matching suggestion.
Click the check-in date, then the check-out date, in the calendar.
Click the 'Number of rooms and guests' button and use the Increment buttons to set rooms, adults and children (set child age if asked); click Update.
Click Search.
On the results page, open the sort menu and choose a sort (e.g. Distance, then Price (low to high)).
Optionally tick filters (review score, hotel class, Free internet, Style, Amenities such as Air-conditioned) to narrow results.
parameters: number of children and their ages

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris, France; 27 Mar to 2 Apr; 2 rooms, 3 guests; sorted Distance, then Price (low to high).

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search (one-way, with passengers and cabin)
opportunities.description: Search Qatar Airways for a one-way flight from an origin to a destination on a chosen date with given passenger counts and cabin class, then select a fare.
steps: Click 'Book' in the Qatar Airways header (and open Flights / Qatar Stopover if needed).
Click the 'From' field, type the origin city and click the matching airport suggestion.
Click the 'To' field, type the destination city and click the matching suggestion.
Click the 'Depart' date and choose the day in the calendar, then Continue if prompted.
Click 'Passengers / Class', use the +/- buttons for adults, children and infants, choose Economy or Premium (Business/First), and click Confirm.
Click 'Show flights'.
Click the fare card (Economy or Business) for the outbound flight, then 'Select fare'. Repeat for any return flight.

instances.values: Doha DOH to Durban DUR, one way, depart 28 May 2023; 2 adults + 1 infant (3 passengers), Economy; selected Economy Classic QAR 4,980. Reached the Durban page via Explore > Africa > Durban > Discover.

Colombo CMB to New York JFK, one way, depart 24 Jun 2023; passengers adjusted to 3 (2 adults + 1 child), Premium/Business; Show flights; selected Business LKR 1,120,521 (Colombo to Doha) and Business LKR 3,125,932 (Doha to New York).

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel search (Booking.com-powered stays)
opportunities.description: From Qatar Airways' Hotels link, search for hotels in a destination for given check-in/check-out dates and guests, then sort or filter and open a property.
opportunities.site: qatarairways.com (Book > Hotels, results served by Booking.com)
steps: Click 'Book' in the Qatar Airways header, then click the 'Hotels' link.
Click the destination field, type the destination and choose the matching suggestion.
Click the check-in date and then the check-out date in the calendar (use the arrows to change month; or pick a length-of-stay chip such as '1 days').
Click the guests/rooms button, adjust adults, children and rooms with the +/- controls, and click Done.
Click Search.
On results, change 'Sort by' (e.g. Price (lowest first)) or tick filters (e.g. Downtown DC, Free WiFi, 5 stars).
Click 'See availability' on a property, then 'Reserve' where needed.

instances.values: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States; check-in 10 Apr 2023, check-out 16 Apr 2023; 2 adults, 1 room; sorted Price (lowest first).

Washington, District of Columbia, United States; 5 Jun 2023, 1-night stay (6 Jun); 4 adults, 2 rooms; filters Downtown DC, Free WiFi, 5 stars; See availability then Reserve on The St. Regis Washington, D.C. (page dates had been changed to 4-5 Jun, 2 adults by then).
